title: Small helicopter circles the crash site
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Small helicopter circles the crash site, about March 25, 1948 at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think Ken was the first one to tell me about the helicopter. He said all of a sudden a very small helicopter showed up and kind of circled around the crash site, then took off to the northeast.

plain: A researcher named Scott Ramsay, who studies a craft said to have crashed in Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, on March 25, 1948, passes on what local people told him. He says a man named Ken Farley was the first to describe how a very small helicopter suddenly appeared, circled the crash site, and flew off to the northeast. If true, it would mean someone with aircraft was watching the site right after the crash.
